parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Distribution: $X=-1,0,1,2,3$ with probabilities $1/9,2/9,1/9,3/9,2/9$ [B1 B1 B1]. Guidance: award the first mark for correct $X$ values and at least one probability; condone extra values assigned probability 0. Award the second for two correct probabilities linked to their outcomes and the third for the remaining three. If fewer than two probabilities are correct, award SCB1 when the four or five displayed probabilities sum to $1$. Total: 3.
